Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 4), the Planner incorrectly stated that Léo Joannon died on March 28, 1996. The WebSurfer's previous search results clearly showed that Léo Joannon died on March 28, 1969. The Planner hallucinated the year 1996 instead of using the correct year 1969 from the retrieved data. This error led to the incorrect conclusion that the director of Excursion Train died later than the director of Bad Day at Black Rock, whereas in reality, John Sturges (1992) died later than Léo Joannon (1969).
